changelog: v0.31.6: fix AAO removing AntiRippingTag during GC. CollectDependency now MarkEntrypoint + adds Transform dependency, so AAO Trace and Optimize keeps the tag alive until our AssetNameObfuscation pass runs after AAO. Without this, v0.31.5 produced a bake where _assets sub-assets and AAOGeneratedMesh_* were not renamed because the obfuscation pass exited early on tag null.
